description: Senators Highlight Impact of Childcare Costs on Families FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE HERMANTOWN, MN. — Yesterday, Senator Grant Hauschild (SD3), Senator Erin Maye Quade (SD56), and Senate candidate Mary Carlson (SD11) met with childcare providers to discuss the rising cost of childcare. During his first term, Senator Hauschild and Senator Maye Quade championed several childcare bills. […]
